reason: issuer root is outside the relying party's accepted-root set
description: Valid brokered receipt under a root outside policy.

reason: delegation validity interval does not contain the carrier event time
description: Brokered receipt with an expired delegation.

reason: action class is not in the delegation's scope
description: Brokered receipt scoped to enrichment, used for a mutation.

reason: receipt names a different carrier message id than the carrier record
description: Brokered receipt bound to a different carrier message id.

reason: broker mapping sends two issuer identities under different roots to one alias
description: Broker normalises two issuers under different roots to one alias.

reason: two accepted roots assert incompatible issuer status; fail closed
description: Brokered receipt whose accepted roots disagree about issuer status.

reason: no status list accompanies a delegation that names a status source
description: Brokered receipt without the status list the delegation names.

reason: evidence presented later than the freshness window after its timestamp
description: Brokered receipt presented a day after its timestamp.

reason: receipt response digest differs from the carrier record's response body digest
description: Brokered receipt whose response digest differs from the carrier's.

reason: timestamp time minus carrier event time exceeds the binding age limit (a replayed or late-bound carrier event)
description: Brokered receipt bound to a carrier event older than the binding age limit.
